name: Luxury Paris Fashion Queen
image_purpose: luxury apparel and accessories lookbook image

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-luxury full-body fashion editorial portrait in an elegant Parisian-style interior.
prompt.main_subject: An adult fictional woman with long straight light-brown hair, oversized black sunglasses, bold nude makeup, glossy lips, and a confident expression. She sits on a white marble fireplace mantel with crossed legs, wearing a black opaque structured lace-trim fashion bodysuit, opaque patterned tights, black pointed heels, a rich brown faux-fur coat draped over her shoulders, and a small generic vintage-style handbag.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body seated pose, elegant crossed legs, classic white wall panels, gold-framed mirror, champagne bottles and glasses on the mantel, clean luxury composition.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cinematic soft lighting with high contrast, sharp subject focus, shallow depth of field, premium Parisian luxury atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-realistic 4K fashion magazine photography, full-body framing, realistic textile and marble detail, natural proportions, no visible brand marks or text.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-luxury full-body fashion editorial portrait of an adult fictional woman with long straight light-brown hair, oversized black sunglasses, bold nude makeup and glossy lips, sitting confidently on a white marble fireplace mantel with legs crossed. She wears a black opaque structured lace-trim fashion bodysuit, opaque patterned tights, black pointed high heels, a rich brown faux-fur coat draped over her shoulders, and carries a small generic vintage-style handbag. Elegant Parisian interior, classic white wall panels, gold-framed mirror, champagne bottles and glasses, cinematic soft high-contrast lighting, sharp focus, shallow depth of field, ultra-realistic 4K.
prompt.negative_prompt: celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, transparent fabric, nudity, recognizable designer monogram, trademark logo, blurry, low quality, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, watermark, text, signature

assets.name: luxury-paris-fashion-queen.jpg
assets.usage: Reference the seated mantel composition, faux-fur coat, sunglasses, Parisian interior, and luxury palette while replacing visible designer branding with generic details.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve pose, environment, palette, lighting, and editorial consistency. Keep the adult identity fictional and replaceable; convert deep or sheer exposure to opaque fashion coverage, replace monograms and logos with generic patterns, and keep typography absent.

changes: Converted revealing and designer-branded styling to opaque, generic fashion details and retained an adult fictional subject.
